text.p: Estiko, packaging concern and retailer, had a consolidated net profit of 4.86 million kroons in six months, up 25.9 percent from the same period last year, it said on Wednesday.
Estiko's turnover was 123 million kroons in the six months, up 10.4 percent compared to the figure a year ago, it added in a statement.
Estiko has exceeded its first-half net profit estimate of 4.57 million kroons and that of net turnover of 114 million kroons.
Estiko spokesperson Ilona Leib told Reuters that the board has not discussed raising its 1997 profit estimate of 8.54 million kroons.
Estiko plans to invest over 100 million kroons this year which would result in a doubling of its retail turnover and a 70 percent rise in production, it added.
